basic_details.job_title: KVK OUAT Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 25 Stenographer, Farm Manager and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Farm Manager, Programme Assistant, and Stenographer

important_dates.written test / skill test date: To be notified in due course

application_fee.details: The application fees shall be deposited directly through Green Channel Counter (GCC) / Internet Banking / Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) in the Account No. of the Comptroller, OUAT (A/C No. 10173711536 of State Bank of India, OUAT Campus Branch, Bhubaneswar, Branch Code 03341, IFSC Code SBIN 0003341). The application fee is non-refundable.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit is 30 years for Farm Manager and Programme Assistant, and 27 years for Stenographer as on the last date of application. Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

qualification.details: Candidates must be Indian nationals. Candidates must have passed Odia as one of the subjects up to 7th standard.

salary_details.farm manager: Rs. 35,400–1,12,400/- (7th Pay) PB-2, Pay- Rs. 9,300–34,800/- Plus with GP Rs. 4,200/- (pre-revised)
salary_details.programme assistant: Rs. 35,400–1,12,400/- (7th Pay) PB-2, Pay- Rs. 9,300–34,800/- Plus with GP Rs. 4,200/- (pre-revised)
salary_details.stenographer: Rs. 25,500–81,100/- (7th Pay) PB-1, Pay- Rs. 5,200–20,200/- Plus with GP Rs. 2,400/- (pre-revised)

selection_process: Written Test (Farm Manager & Programme Assistant) Subject neutral common questions related to job profile and subject specific question 150 multiple choice questions 150 marks 02 hours
Written Test (Stenographer) General English, General Awareness, and Quantitative Aptitude 150 objective multiple-choice questions (50 marks from each field) 150 marks 02 hours
The selection is based purely on the marks secured in the written test for Farm Manager and Programme Assistant. For the post of Stenographer
the mark secured in the skill test will be added to the score obtained in the written test to prepare the final merit list.
Qualifying marks in written test: Un-reserved (UR) - 50%
candidates shall be called for the Skill Test at 1:4 ratio from the merit list prepared considering the written test.
how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form and information sheet from the official website ouat.ac.in.
Deposit the required application fee through Internet Banking, RTGS, or Green Channel Counter (GCC) to the specified Bank Account of the Comptroller, OUAT.
Fill in all entries in the application form clearly in block letters.
Affix a recent color passport size photograph in the designated space on the application form.
Attach self-attested copies of all certificates, mark sheets of all examinations passed, and the original counterfoil of the fee deposit receipt.
Super scribe the envelope containing the application as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ............................................ along with advertisement No. and date."
Send the complete application form through Speed Post / Registered post so as to reach the Registrar, OUAT, Bhubaneswar-751 003 on or before 12 November 2026 (5:00 PM).
important_instructions: Employees are Contractual Project Staff till 100% funding of ICAR continues. Employees are not entitled to terminal benefits and their service is coterminous with the Central project. The candidate must have passed Odia as one of the subjects up to 7th standard. In-service candidates must apply through proper channel with an advance copy and NOC. Applications received after the due date and time will not be entertained. Furnishing of false information will lead to disqualification or termination of service. Transfer of KVK employees will be within the KVKs of OUAT only. On appointment, the candidate shall serve in the KVKs for a minimum period of 01 (one) year and furnish an undertaking.

content_sections.heading: OUAT Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection is based purely on the marks secured in the written test for Farm Manager and Programme Assistant. For Stenographer, candidates shall be called for the Skill Test at 1:4 ratio from the merit list prepared considering the written test.

faq.question: Q1. What is OUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: OUAT Recruitment 2026 is an offline recruitment drive conducted by Odisha University of Agriculture & Technology to fill 25 vacancies for Farm Manager, Programme Assistant, and Stenographer posts under Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under OUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 25 vacancies available, which include 8 for Farm Manager, 12 for Programme Assistant, and 5 for Stenographer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for OUAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 12 November 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Farm Manager and Programme Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s Degree in Agriculture or any other branch of Science/Social Science relevant to agriculture or equivalent qualification from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for OUAT posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years for Farm Manager and Programme Assistant, and 27 years for Stenographer, with age relaxation applicable as per rules.
